title: Consider removing status=published filter from queryCourseBySlug for authenticated users
body: The queryCourseBySlug function was also updated to remove status=published filter for authenticated users. This is consistent with queryPublishedCourses. However, this might be intentional - course detail pages might want to always show published courses regardless of auth status.
rationale: The change was made for consistency, but the behavior difference between /courses listing (now shows draft) and /courses/:slug (would show draft) might be intentional
